m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), project deltas (CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md), and the g1 handoff in full. Verify handoff completeness (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Verify the cited seam (TelemetryStore.read_session + build_db_session) against source before reuse.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete; telemetry seam verified against source

m1-module-core.title: Build src/physics/burn_rate_calibration.py
m1-module-core.imperative: Create the new module: cited per-season FIA fuel-regulation table (flow-rate cap kg/h + max race-start fuel kg, 2019-2026, matching SEASON_BASE_KG's earliest year), a pure per-lap burn formula function, a per-season/per-circuit aggregator using the TelemetryStore/build_db_session seam (no cross-season pooling), and a lap-time-slope cross-check function. Zero fitted parameters; regulatory constants cited inline. Do not touch mass_model.py.

postconditions.statement: module imports cleanly and exposes the regulation table + pure burn function + aggregator + cross-check function

check.command: py -c "import src.physics.burn_rate_calibration as m; assert hasattr(m,'FUEL_REGULATIONS'); assert hasattr(m,'per_lap_burn_kg'); assert hasattr(m,'season_burn_rate_estimate'); assert hasattr(m,'lap_time_slope_cross_check'); print('OK')"

constraints: zero fitted/regressed parameters in the primary estimator
no cross-season/cross-circuit pooling inside the aggregator

payload.cmd: py -c "import src.physics.burn_rate_calibration as m; assert hasattr(m,'FUEL_REGULATIONS'); assert hasattr(m,'per_lap_burn_kg'); assert hasattr(m,'season_burn_rate_estimate'); assert hasattr(m,'lap_time_slope_cross_check'); print('OK')"

m2-unit-tests.title: Unit tests for burn_rate_calibration
m2-unit-tests.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/test_burn_rate_calibration.py: hand-computed pure-formula values, regulation table correctness (>=2023, 2026), and aggregator/cross-check against a small synthetic telemetry-store-shaped fixture (no live DB dependency), following the fixture convention in tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_session_race.py and test_mass_model.py.
constraints: hand-computed expected values for the pure formula
no live DB required for the test suite

m3-validation-script.title: Build scripts/validate_burn_rate_hypothesis.py
m3-validation-script.imperative: Create the runnable script covering seasons 2019-2026 and circuits Bahrain/Spain(-Barcelona-Catalunya 2026)/Silverstone(stored as 'Great Britain')/Monaco: prints throttle-integral kg/lap table, lap-time-slope cross-check table (observed vs model-predicted slope, %error), explicit Monaco-gap callout, SC/VSC-vs-green burn ratio vs SC_BURN_FRACTION (informational), and skips missing/insufficient season+circuit combos with a printed reason instead of crashing.

postconditions.statement: script runs to completion over the full season/circuit grid without crashing

constraints: skip-with-reason on insufficient data, never crash or fake a number

m4-run-evidence.title: Capture full validation run evidence
m4-run-evidence.imperative: Run the validation script and the unit test suite; capture full text output for the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT (per-season/circuit throttle-integral table, lap-time-slope cross-check, Monaco pattern callout, SC/VSC ratio). Report honestly whether the hypothesis holds, including any large unexplained divergence.

postconditions.statement: evidence captured verbatim for the result file

constraints: do not tune the method until it agrees

m5-simplification-limits.title: Simplification limits clean on touched files
m5-simplification-limits.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits against the three touched paths and resolve any violations without expanding scope.
